privacyContract.forgetMe: DELETE /api/arron/memory body {memoryId}. Success is {ok:true, cleared:true}. Do not invent a new header or verifiedClean.
privacyContract.race: A chat that is already running can still save after a wipe. Do not claim the cloud is clear unless the response says cleared.
privacyContract.finance: Sums stay on the device. The adviser still receives the typed question and quote. The profile summary is sent only if consent is checked.
